How Scout makes a decision +

Preferences first. A local simulator extracts value or comfort priority and a nonstop requirement. A future LLM can replace it through the same validated interface.

Math stays deterministic. Each date combines a round-trip flight with a rated hotel for your full stay. Flight and nightly hotel budgets are separate limits. Rating and nonstop requirements are hard filters.

Transparent scoring. Value = max(0, 1 − total ÷ (1.5 × total budget)); quality = rating ÷ 5. Value mode weights these 80/20; comfort mode uses 35/65. Eligible options rank before over-budget options.

Decision rules. CHANGE DATE if the best qualifying date differs from your earliest date and saves at least 5%, or the earliest date does not qualify. Otherwise BOOK. WAIT if nothing qualifies; this is not a price forecast.

All quotes are synthetic, in USD, and modeled as tax-inclusive. Baggage, transfers, meals, and activities are excluded. No booking or live availability is provided.
